prompt: A cinematic shot of a futuristic city at dusk, neon lights reflecting on wet streets

cand-a3-tp2.description: First Ascend (a3) draft: 2 cards, tensor-parallel 2 (weights ~64 GB bf16 exceed one 64 GB card).
cand-a3-tp2.notes: Draft for the first Ascend round (2026-11-25): FLUX.2-dev is ~32B bf16 (~64 GB weights) -- a single 64 GB 910C cannot hold it (OOM at load), and Ulysses shards activations, not weights, so tensor parallel is the memory fix. VALIDATION PENDING with a known risk: if sglang falls back to the native diffusers transformer on torch_npu (the wan22 finding), the fallback cannot honor tp_size=2 either and this cell errors -- then FLUX.2-dev is honestly unservable on torch_npu with this sglang build and gets recorded as such. The local snapshot must also be a complete diffusers layout (model_index.json present) -- same incomplete-download check as zimage.
